saw_lines: Treadmill buyers compare decks, motors and warranties, then wait for a reason to trust the price before they commit.
So the sale is won in the first ad, where a new buyer looks for a reason to trust the price.
Your site leads with a 30-day guarantee and 10,000+ customers, yet no Meta ad carries either. Launch three ads opening on the guarantee, one each for the F80, F85 and E25.
ads_1: Guarantee-led Meta creative for the F80, F85 and E25 treadmills and ellipticals
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter and Youtube
